subject: english
stem: The speakers have just checked the class notice. What is the main purpose of this conversation?
options: a question about tickets for the science room
an invitation to the Thursday school show at the science room
an invitation to a show at the science room on Saturday
a request to move the show from the science room

optionRationales.reason: a question about tickets for the science room：此項把「an invitation to the Thursday school show at」改成「a question about tickets for」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Thursday school show at the science room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Thursday school show at the science room」。
an invitation to the Thursday school show at the science room：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Thursday school show at the science room」。

an invitation to a show at the science room on Saturday：此項把「the Thursday school show at the science room」改成「a show at the science room on Saturday」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Thursday school show at the science room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Thursday school show at the science room」。

a request to move the show from the science room：此項把「an invitation to the Thursday school show at」改成「a request to move the show from」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Thursday school show at the science room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Thursday school show at the science room」。
